results.description:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

Cold turkey works for almost no one. Stepdown gets you off nicotine by stepping down; small, scheduled reductions your body barely notices, until one day the number is zero.

Works for vapes, nicotine pouches, cigarettes, nicotine gum, lozenges, heated tobacco and snus.

Answer a few questions and see, free: your Nic Score (how tight a grip nicotine actually has on your day), your personal staircase, and your projected quit date.

YOUR STAIRCASE
- A plan of small steps; each one holds your daily limit slightly lower while your body adjusts
- One-tap logging for every pouch, puff, pod or cigarette
- An AI coach that knows your exact plan and answers at 2am
- A panic button for cravings; most pass in about three minutes
- Danger-window alerts that fire before your risky hours, not after
- Step briefings, daily debriefs, and body-recovery milestones
- A savings jar showing the money you keep instead of burn

WHY STEPPING DOWN WORKS
Quitting all at once means peak withdrawal, peak irritability, and peak chance of a bad day that convinces you that you can't do it. Stepping down spreads that cost across weeks, so no single day has to be the day you quit quitting.

WENT OVER? KEEP GOING
Go over your limit and nothing resets. The staircase adjusts astreak to break and no starting over.

FREE
Your Nic Score, staircase preview, and quit date.

A subscription is required for the full plan, coach, and tracking. Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple
Account settings.

Stepdown is a habit app, not a medical service. It does not prnosis, or treatment. If you have a medical concern, talk to ahealthcare provider.

WHY THIS QUIT VAPING APP WORKS WHEN OTHER THINGS HAVEN'T
95% of people can't quit nicotine cold turkey — successful quitting requires rewiring habits, daily motivation, and craving support. Jones combines proven cognitive behavioral therapy techniques, nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) via Jones Mints, an AI quit coach, and an active, supportive peer community.

Fun fact: Quitters who check in 5 times are 2.1x more likely to be vape-free by day 30.
"I just want to recognize this app, Jones, for being my main reason I have not relapsed on vaping. I don't know where I would be without this community. Thank you!!" - Jones community member

PAIR THE APP WITH NRT
Jones mints are on-the-go nicotine replacement therapy (NRT), FDA-approved to help quit smoking or quit vaping. Get your custom science-backed taper plan in the app to wean from 4mg to 2mg to 0. App users get early access, discounts, and exclusive perks on new Jones NRT releases.

DOES IT WORK IF YOU'VE TRIED TO QUIT VAPING BEFORE?
That's exactly who Jones was built for. We're former vapers who tried everything to quit nicotine. The app helps you understand your triggers — stress, boredom, social situations — so you can replace them with healthy, sustainable habits.

DOES IT WORK FOR QUITTING SMOKING, NOT JUST VAPING?
Yes. Jones works for cigarette smokers, vapers, and nicotine pouch users (Zyn, On!, Rogue). Tell us your habit, usage, and goals, and Jones builds your personalized quit plan around it.

HOW IT WORKS: YOUR PERSONALIZED QUIT VAPING PLAN
Check in daily to log nicotine use and mood

Celebrate your quit vaping wins & milestones — 134,000+ celebrated by the community

WHEN A NICOTINE CRAVING HITS
Two ways to beat a vaping or smoking craving in under 60 seconds. Quittle, Jones' in-app craving game, gives your brain something to do instead of reaching for a vape. Or try the guided breathing exercise — designed to get you through the craving and out the other side.

"Jones really has changed my life. When I get a craving for a puff, I take a mint and take deep breaths as if I'm hitting my vape. Never thought it would be this easy." - Jones community member

THE COMMUNITY THAT KEEPS YOU GOING
The only quit-nicotine app with an active, supportive, and accountable social community. Add friends to a quit pod, stop vaping or smoking together, and celebrate milestones as a crew. You don't have to do it alone!

COACH JONES — YOUR 24/7 QUIT VAPING COACH
Nicotine cravings don't stick to business hours. Get help whenever a craving strikes. Coach will help you identify triggers, reframe cravings, and stay on track with your quit plan.

TRACK YOUR QUIT VAPING PROGRESS AND SAVINGS
Track your nicotine usage and how many days you've gone vape free!
See how much money you're saving — users report $200–$2,800+!
Start feeling better from minute one — lungs, heart, and gut are healing

When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.

COMMUNITY: THE EX-SMOKERS’ CHAT
Having a smoke-free environment is crucial when you quit. QuitNow offers a chat full of people who, like you, have said goodbye to tobacco. Sharing your journey with other ex-smokers will make your path easier.

LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING
Some people prefer a more structured method when they quit. That’s why QuitNow includes a step-by-step course designed to guide you throughout the entire quitting process. It works like a digital book, but integrated inside the app.

MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING
As with any task in life, quitting is easier when you break the challenge into smaller goals. That’s why QuitNow offers 80 milestones based on the cigarettes you’ve avoided, the days you’ve gone without smoking, and the money you’ve saved. This way, you can start celebrating your wins from day one.

YOUR HEALTH AS AN EX-SMOKER
In QuitNow you’ll find a list of health indicators that show how your body improves day by day. These indicators are the same ones published by the World Health Organization, and we update them as soon as the WHO does.

Plus, QuitNow includes other sections designed to help you on your journey to quit smoking.

QUITNOW AI
Whenever questions come up during your quitting process, you can turn to QuitNow AI. It’s designed to provide clear, reliable information, based on our course and on data from the World Health Organization.

BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING
Learning techniques and approaches to quit can make the process much easier. That’s why we’ve selected well-known books that can effectively help you on your path to a tobacco-free life.

ALSO ON YOUR WATCH
QuitNow’s Apple Watch app and its widgets and tiles let you track your progress, see how much you’ve saved, and check your smoke-free stats right from your wrist.

Because we dedicate so much time and effort to it, we firmly believe QuitNow is the best app to quit smoking. As always, there’s room for improvement—so if you have any idea to make QuitNow even better, please write to us at ios@quitnow.app.

Have you considered quitting smoking? Whether you’ve already quit smoking or you’re still thinking about it, QuitNow PRO will help you quit tobacco for good.

Quitting smoking is one of the best decisions you can make for your health: it reduces your risk of disease, you regain energy, you save money, and you also protect the people around you. But the truth is, quitting isn’t easy.

That’s where QuitNow PRO comes in.

QuitNow PRO was born in 2011, created by a smoker who wanted to quit. Since then, we’ve grown, brought in addiction specialists, and refined our tools so you can quit tobacco for good:

YOUR EX-SMOKER STATUS
When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow PRO’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.

COMMUNITY: THE EX-SMOKERS’ CHAT
Having a smoke-free environment is crucial when you quit. QuitNow PRO offers a chat full of people who, like you, have said goodbye to tobacco. Sharing your journey with other ex-smokers will make your path easier.

LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING
Some people prefer a more structured method when they quit. That’s why QuitNow PRO includes a step-by-step course designed to guide you throughout the entire quitting process. It works like a digital book, but integrated inside the app.

MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING
As with any task in life, quitting is easier when you break the challenge into smaller goals. That’s why QuitNow PRO offers 80 milestones based on the cigarettes you’ve avoided, the days you’ve gone without smoking, and the money you’ve saved. This way, you can start celebrating your wins from day one.

YOUR HEALTH AS AN EX-SMOKER
In QuitNow PRO you’ll find a list of health indicators that show how your body improves day by day. These indicators are the same ones published by the World Health Organization, and we update them as soon as the WHO does.

Plus, QuitNow PRO includes other sections designed to help you on your journey to quit smoking.

QUITNOW AI
Whenever questions come up during your quitting process, you can turn to QuitNow PRO AI. It’s designed to provide clear, reliable information, based on our course and on data from the World Health Organization.

BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING
Learning techniques and approaches to quit can make the process much easier. That’s why we’ve selected well-known books that can effectively help you on your path to a tobacco-free life.

ALSO ON YOUR WATCH
QuitNow PRO’s Apple Watch app and its widgets and tiles let you track your progress, see how much you’ve saved, and check your smoke-free stats right from your wrist.

Because we dedicate so much time and effort to it, we firmly believe QuitNow PRO is the best app to quit smoking. As always, there’s room for improvement—so if you have any idea to make QuitNow PRO even better, please write to us at ios@quitnow.app.

We truly hope QuitNow PRO supports you on your journey to a tobacco-free life.

Spacer is built on a single, powerful idea from addiction science: willpower alone is hard to sustain — so instead of relying on it, you wear the habit down slowly.

Using Progressive Interval Recovery, Spacer helps you regain control over any habit. Whether it's an event (like smoking or taking a pill) or a duration (like doomscrolling or gaming). Instead of demanding you quit "cold turkey", Spacer gently stretches the time between your uses, gradually lowering your baseline while respecting your body's rhythm.

WHY SPACER IS DIFFERENT
• No Streaks, No Shame: A single slip shouldn't erase months of progress. Spacer tracks your true baseline. If you slip, just log it honestly—your data adjusts, but you never go back to zero.
• Cold State Rule: Decisions about your recovery should be made when you are calm. Changes to your pace take effect the next day, preventing impulsive choices during a craving.
• Total Privacy: Your data never leaves your device. There are no accounts, no cloud syncs, and no telemetry. Your recovery is your business.

KEY FEATURES
• Progressive Delay: Spacer automatically calculates when you can use next, gently increasing the gap each time.
• Urge Surfing Toolkit: When a craving hits early, Spacer provides immediate, evidence-based tools: 4-7-8 breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercises, and voice memos you record yourself to remind you why you started.
• Emergency Bypass: Recovery isn't perfectly linear. If you genuinely need to use, the emergency bypass lets you do so while adjusting your progress proportionally, preventing the "all-or-nothing" guilt spiral.
• Accountability Partner: Automatically send beautifully formatted, context-free progress reports to someone you trust, without exposing your private journals or slip times.
• Deep Insights: Identify your triggers, see your success rate when surfing urges, and view time-of-day heatmaps so you know exactly when you are most vulnerable.

Whether you are tapering off screens, habits, or substances, Spacer gives you the structure and the grace to recover at a pace that works.

Medical Warning: Abruptly stopping certain substances (like Alcohol, Benzodiazepines, Barbiturates, or Opioids) can cause severe medical complications. Spacer is a supplementary tool and does not replace medical supervision.

results.description:
ExSmoke is an app created to help you quit cigarettes, vaping or tobacco use of any kind and lead a healthy life free from smoking. The app can help you in each part of your quitting journey like tracking, cessation and eventually quitting altogether.

The app has 3 modes:

1. Tracker: In this mode, you can simply log your daily cigarette consumption. You select a daily smoke limit and the app will recommend times during the day when you can smoke to ensure you stick to the limit.

2. Reduce: This is where you start your smoking cessation journey rather than just logging in track mode. You set a quit date and the app will automatically reduce your smoking limit everyday up until 0 smoke limit on the quit date. You can still continue to use the smoking tracker features and see the recommended next smoke time to stick to your daily limit.

3. Quit: This is where you stop smoking completely, and the app helps you track how many cigarettes you have avoided. It also helps you estimate the amount of money you have saved and track all the health improvements you go through when you quit cigarettes/vaping. You’ll get good visibility into how your blood pressure, heart rate, and blood oxygen level improves. It also tracks over 15 years how your body changes, improvements in lung function and reduction in heart diseases and various other conditions.

The app also uses push notifications to remind you to track and log your cigarette consumption and also keep yourself within your smoking limits. In the quit mode, the app will also update your whenever certain health markers improve.

The journey to quitting with ExSmoke is enriched by our comprehensive health monitoring features, seamlessly integrating with Apple Health. This pivotal connection unlocks the door to a detailed view of how smoking impacts crucial biological markers, including SPO2 (oxygen saturation), VO2Max (maximum oxygen uptake), blood oxygen levels, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, average sleep duration, and average energy expenditure.

By tracking these vital health indicators, ExSmoke provides you with a crystal-clear understanding of the daily effects of smoking on your body. More importantly, it offers a quantifiable glimpse into the ways your health begins to improve once you embark on your journey to be free from smoking.

That’s not all, ExSmoke has a few more tools that will help you in your cigarette/vaping free journey and be a better smoking tracker than ever before.

Monthly Calendar View: Our monthly calendar view is a standout feature, crafted to provide you with a comprehensive overview of your progress. Each month, you can easily monitor the days you've successfully stayed within your predetermined smoking limits or, better yet, remained completely cigarette-free. This visual representation serves not just as a smoking tracker but as a motivator, encouraging you to extend your streak of smoke/vape free days and visually documenting your journey towards better health.

iOS Widgets: Use iOS widgets to track these data points directly in your iPhone home screen without the need to open the app. 

By harnessing the power of visual cues and effortless tracking, ExSmoke not only assists in managing your smoking habits but also integrates into your lifestyle, making your health and smoking cessation goals a natural part of your daily routine.

The app also has 7 beautiful themes that change how the app and the widgets look. Use them to give ExSmoke your own personal touch.

Lastly, we wish you all the best in your quitting journey. Best of luck!

Open Quffy. Tap once to log a cigarette, vape, or heated tobacco use. Done. Do that every day. Within a week, you'll see something you've never seen before: your habit in numbers. How much you actually smoke. When you smoke the most. What triggers it.

YOUR PERSONAL QUIT PLAN — BUILT BY AI
No two smokers are the same. So why follow the same plan? Quffy's AI analyzes your smoking patterns, habits, and history — then creates a personalized step-by-step plan to help you quit. Not generic "smoke less" advice. A real plan with real targets, adjusted to your pace, your schedule, and your life.

AI THAT KNOWS YOUR TRIGGERS
Stress at work? Drinks with friends? That 10-minute window after lunch? Quffy's AI identifies your personal smoking triggers and suggests specific strategies to get past them. Not willpower. Not "just breathe." Actual alternatives tailored to your patterns.

TRACK EVERY CIGARETTE, VAPE & IQOS
One tap to log. Cigarettes, e-cigarettes, disposable vapes, heated tobacco — all in one place. Daily, weekly, and monthly stats show your real consumption. No guessing. No lying to yourself. Just data.

SET YOUR OWN LIMITS
You decide the rules. Smoke 20 a day? Set a limit of 15. Hit that for a week, then drop to 12. Then 10. Quffy tracks your progress toward your daily limit in real time — and tells you when you're getting close. Small cuts add up fast.

TEST YOUR ADDICTION LEVEL
Quffy includes a nicotine dependency test based on the Fagerström scale — the same tool doctors and clinicians use worldwide. Take it now. Take it again in a month. Watch the score drop. That's not motivation — that's proof.

SEE THE CHANGE HAPPEN
Charts don't lie. See your daily count go down. See your streaks get longer. See the gap between your worst week and your best week grow wider. Progress you can point to and say: I did that.

STAY IN THE GAME

CLEAN. FAST. NO NOISE.

FREE TO START

WHO QUFFY IS FOR
Smokers who want to smoke less starting now — even if quitting feels far away
Vapers burning through pods and looking to cut back
Heated tobacco users who want to see their real numbers
People who tried cold turkey, patches, gum — and none of it stuck

results.description:
On the day you stop, Home is a bed of coals with one seed in it.

Reach a milestone and the plant standing there grows. It never shrinks again — not on the day you slip, not the week after.

ONE QUIT, NOT THREE
Cigarettes, a vape, pouches, snus, dip: tick whatever you actually use. Burnout puts them on one clock, because that is how your body meets them. Somebody who moved off cigarettes onto pouches is still in the middle of one quit, and this app treats it that way.

THE THREE DAYS
Nicotine has a half-life of roughly two hours, so it is out of you inside about three days. Burnout counts those hours down from your own last one and names the phase you are standing in. The third day is usually the hardest, and it has an end you can see.

MILESTONES THAT NAME THEIR SOURCE
Twenty minutes. Twelve hours. Then day one and day three, week one, week two, month one, month three, half a year, a year, five years, ten, fifteen. Open any mark and the fact arrives with the body that publishes it: NHS, WHO, CDC, the US Surgeon General's report. Where those bodies disagree — and on the heart at one year they do — you get the range they disagree across, never the number that sounds best.

SIX ORGANS, SIX CLOCKS
Lungs, heart, brain, circulation, skin, gums. Each moves on the curve its own evidence supports: circulation improving across two to twelve weeks, coughing and wheezing easing over three to nine months. Nothing here is allowed to run ahead of what is known.

WHEN THE URGE ARRIVES
Four ways through it, none of them behind a price: breathe on a set count, run a clock and sit with the pull until it drops, read back the reasons you wrote in your own words, or spend ten minutes on small errands. Write down what you rode out and it becomes evidence for the next one.

STOP TODAY, OR STEP DOWN TO IT
Set a date and start the clearance now, or build a ramp that walks your daily count to zero by a day you can point at on a calendar. Both are real quitting.

RAIN, NOT RUIN
A slip brings weather over the timeline for a while. It does not fell the plant and it does not take back one milestone you reached. Your longest run stays on the record beside the new one, and the comeback can begin the same evening.

THE MONEY YOU KEPT
What you did not spend on cigarettes, pods or cans stacks up in front of you, day by day. Pro opens the rest of that picture: the line week by week, what the habit would have cost by now, and what the same money does if you leave it alone.

ALSO INSIDE
· A day-by-day calendar of your whole record
· A recovery score built from four measured parts
· Withdrawal symptoms set against the windows they are measured to run in
· Your weight against the average gain published for people who stop
· Painted badges for every milestone behind you
· Reminders you set yourself, and one export file that carries all of it to your next phone
· No account and no sign-up: it starts counting the minute you open it
· Five languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese

BURNOUT PRO
Pro adds the ninety-day projection for each organ, the journal, home-screen widgets, your milligrams of nicotine week by week, the weight and symptom logs, the whole money picture, and every day of history behind the last thirty. Monthly, yearly, or one payment that ends it. The timeline, the milestones, the three-day clearance, the urge tools and the running total of what you kept cost nothing and stay that way.

Burnout is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Talk to your doctor about stopping, particularly if you take medication or use nicotine replacement.

progress bar. Just the sky, telling the truth.

Quitting nicotine is hard—at least, it used to be. Meet Nix, the AI-powered app that helps you break free from vaping, ZYNing, smoking, and anything else that keeps you hooked. Whether you’re using an e-cig, pouches, or cigarettes, Nix provides hour-by-hour recommendations and a science-backed plan to help you quit for good—mostly without the withdrawal.

Why Choose Nix?

AI + Science

Nix’s cutting-edge AI is trained on:
1.	Real success stories from people who have already beaten nicotine addiction.
2.	Evidence-based research from addiction science and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT).

This unique blend of real-world data and proven techniques means Nix can tailor a plan specifically for you—your lifestyle, your cravings, and your goals.

Personalized Quit Plan
•	Hourly Recommendations: Our AI learns your consumption habits—whether you vape, smoke cigarettes, or use pouches—and tells you exactly when it’s time for your next (and gradually fewer) puffs. No more guesswork.
•	Cravings & Withdrawal Control: Struggling with mood swings, restlessness, or brain fog? Nix helps reduce nicotine cravings and alleviates common withdrawal symptoms like irritability and fatigue, so you can continue your daily life with fewer disruptions.
•	Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) Techniques: Get guided exercises and coping strategies designed to shift your mindset and replace old habits with healthier, more rewarding ones.

Track Your Progress
•	Consumption Logger: Easily record every puff, patch, or pouch. You can even track specifics like e-liquid flavors or brand preferences.
•	Nicotine Level Tracking: Many vapers don’t realize they might be consuming the equivalent of several packs of cigarettes each day. Nix calculates your daily nicotine intake (in mg) so you can see at a glance how much you’re using—and how it’s changing over time.
•	Achievements & Milestones: Celebrate victories big and small. Watch your numbers drop, your health improve, and your confidence grow as you move closer to a nicotine-free life.

Minimize Withdrawal, Maximize Success

Nix tackles the hardest parts of quitting:
•	Reduced Cravings: By timing your nicotine use more effectively, our AI helps you gradually decrease your dependence, so the urge to reach for another puff or pouch becomes easier to manage.
•	No Guesswork: We do the math for you. Nix’s guidance is powered by advanced machine learning algorithms and proven therapeutic approaches, taking the pressure off you to figure out the “how” and letting you focus on the “why.”
•	Cutting-Edge Research: Our recommendations are rooted in the latest findings from addiction science, so you know you’re getting advice that’s both practical and effective.

Who Is Nix For?
•	Vapers: Whether you’re trying to quit vaping e-liquids or dispose of your e-cigs, Nix’s AI will create a personalized roadmap to reduce your usage safely and gradually.
•	Smokers: If you’ve been trying to quit cigarettes for years, or if you just started, Nix provides daily tips to help you stop smoking—once and for all.
•	Pouch Users & More: Nicotine pouches, patches, gum—whatever your preferred method, Nix supports you on your journey to total nicotine freedom.

Ready to live a nicotine-free life? Nix is here to guide you—step by step. With Nix, you can finally break the cycle of addiction.

Subscription Required
Users can try logging their consumption to decide if the process is easy enough (good!) or if it's too cumbersome (less good!). To use the app's functionality, including personalized quit plans and real-time recommendations, you must sign up for a subscription within the app. By subscribing, you agree to our Terms (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and Privacy Policy (https://www.quitnix.ai/privacy)

Nix's optional Apple Health integration provides Nix with sleep data, which we may use to better tailor recommendations that reduce withdrawal symptoms, like sleep disturbances.

results.description:
Quitting Cold Turkey Doesn’t Work — Here’s Why:
Studies show that quitting vaping/smoking cold turkey is one of the least effective methods. According to the Mayo Clinic, only 3 out of 100 people succeed when they try to quit their addiction without support.

Many turn to nicotine replacement therapies (NRTs) like patches, gum, or lozenges, but here’s the problem: without a clear plan or guidance, it’s easy to fall back into old habits and end up right where you started.

That’s Where KICK THE NIC Comes In.
We’re the ONLY app designed specifically to help you quit vaping. Unlike other methods, KICK THE NIC builds a gradual, personalized plan based on your habits—making quitting achievable and not overwhelming.

Take Control with KICK THE NIC:

Personalized Plans: Take our quiz to create a custom KICK PLAN tailored to your vaping habits and goals.
Track Your Success: Log your daily puffs, monitor your streaks, and see real-time progress with clear graphs.
See Your Gains: Track every penny and every minute you've saved for every craving that you beat.
Celebrate Wins: Share your progress with friends to stay motivated and inspired.

Here’s How It Works:
1. Create Your KICK PLAN
Choose a 30, 60, or 90-day challenge tailored to your habits. This gradual approach helps you reduce your vaping without the stress of quitting cold turkey.
2. Log Every Puff
Use the app’s Puff Tracker or Shortcut feature (double-tap your phone) to log each hit. Honest tracking keeps you on target.
3. Stay Under Your Daily Limit
Every day, the app sets a puff limit to keep you on track. The goal? Stay under the limit as it gradually decreases toward zero.
4. Visualize Your Progress
Track your streaks, good days, and bad days. Watch your savings grow and your nicotine-free days add up. Every milestone is a reason to celebrate!
5. Kick the Habit for Good
On the final day of your plan, hit zero puffs and officially quit vaping. With KICK THE NIC, you’re not just quitting—you’re reclaiming your life.
6. Restart If Needed
Slipped up? No problem. Life happens, and we’re here to help you get back on track whenever you’re ready.

Why Wait? Join the Movement and #KickTheNic Today!
Quitting doesn’t have to be impossible. With KICK THE NIC, you’re not alone—you’ve got a guide, a plan, and a community behind you.

Note: KICK THE NIC requires a $7.99 / week subscription, with a 3 DAY TRIAL PERIOD

Open it and there's one thing waiting: a three-minute ritual. A tree
grows while you wait. It asks you nothing and it isn't a distraction —
it's something to do with the next few minutes, and something to look
at afterwards that wasn't there before.

Keep the tree or don't. Share it or don't.

FREE

results.description:
Nixotine — Quit Vaping or Quit Drinking

Cravings peak and pass in about five minutes. Nixotine gets you through every
one of them — then shows you exactly what you've clawed back. Fully offline, no
account, and nothing about you ever leaves your phone.

PICK YOUR TRACK

Quitting nicotine and quitting alcohol are different fights, so Nixotine treats
them that way. Choose vaping or alcohol when you start and get a plan tuned to
it — your own recovery timeline, your own triggers, your own numbers. Switch
anytime in Profile: each track keeps its own streak, journal and village exactly
where you left them.

BUILT FOR VAPING, NOT RETROFITTED FROM CIGARETTES

Set up around what you actually use — disposables, pod systems, refillable mods
or nicotine pouches. Nixotine counts the puffs you didn't take, the nicotine you
didn't absorb and the money you didn't spend. And if cold turkey isn't the plan,
it builds you a real week-by-week milligram taper down to zero.

BUILT FOR DRINKING TOO

Beer, wine, spirits or a bit of everything. Nixotine counts the drinks you
skipped, the calories you avoided and the money you kept, against a recovery
timeline written for alcohol — deep sleep returning at 48 hours, the fog lifting
at 72, liver fat dropping at a month.

WHEN THE CRAVING HITS

One tap gets you a single concrete thing to do right now: 4-7-8 breathing, a
five-minute walk, a cold reset, 20 hard reps, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, one full song.
No quiz, no lecture, no interrogation about whether you slipped. Pick one, do it,
the urge passes. All of it works with no signal and no internet.

A SLIP IS NOT A RESET

Most quit apps punish you by wiping your number. Nixotine logs the trigger
instead and keeps your total clean days counting. Relapse is information about
what set you off, and that information is the thing that gets you out.

WATCH SOMETHING GROW

Every day you open the app and every craving you ride out earns materials, and
your builders lay them automatically. A foundation becomes walls, walls become a
finished home, and homes become a street, a neighbourhood, a village, a town.
You don't manage it or spend anything — you just show up, and it grows.

ALSO INSIDE

• A live streak down to the second, plus money saved
• A recovery timeline of what's repairing in your body right now
• Milestones from your first hour to your first year
• A calendar of every clean day and every logged slip
• Trigger logging that shows you your real patterns
• A journal for mood and free-writing
• One daily reminder, at a time you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Everything you log is stored on
your device and stays there — we don't run servers that collect your data, so
there is nothing for us to see, sell or leak. The app works completely offline.

NIXOTINE PRO

Unlock the full plan: your complete recovery timeline, the calendar, unlimited
journal history and your personal nicotine taper. One purchase covers both
tracks. Choose monthly or yearly (the yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial),
or buy Lifetime once and own it. Prices are shown in your local currency on the
purchase screen before you confirm anything.

Subscriptions auto-renew at the then-current price unless cancelled at least 24
hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple ID is charged on
confirmation of purchase, and renewals are billed within 24 hours before the
period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings —
cancelling stops future renewals and you keep access until the end of the paid
period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a
subscription.

Nomo has tons of optional features like an encouragement wall from the community, accountability partner searching, clock sharing, private messaging with partners, milestone tokens, journaling, daily inventory check-ins, little games/exercises to help you refocus when you're tempted, and tons more!

•  Send a notification to partners when you're feeling tempted

•  Send/Receive notifications when a clock has been reset

•  Get a detailed breakdown of your progress down to the minute

•  See how much money you've saved by not supporting your habit

•  Earn tokens when you reach certain milestones in your recovery

•  Submit and read encouragements from the community

•  View all of your tokens at once to keep you encouraged

•  Tap the “check in” button on your shared clocks to show accountability partners that you’re active in your sobriety

•  Keep a daily inventory with morning and evening check-ins

•  Mini-distraction exercises to help you refocus when you’re feeling tempted

Nomo is perfect for anyone recovering from Alcohol, Anger, Body Dysmorphia, Benzodiazepines, Caffeine, Cheating, Chewing Tobacco, Codependency, Contact, Control, Exercise, Depression, Dermatillomania, Drugs, Fighting, Food, Gambling, Hallucinogens, Hoarding, Inhalants, Internet, Kleptomania, Laziness, Lying, Masturbation, Nicotine, Onychophagia, Opioids, Painkillers, Perfectionism, Pornography, Procrastination, Pyromania, Relationships, Self-harm, Sex, Shame, Smoking, Social Media, Shopping, Steroids, Stimulants, Stress, Sugar, Tanning, Texting, Trichotillomania, Tobacco, Video Games, Work, or any other kind of hurt, habit, or hangup.
